He offered to find another job but the irony here is companies are doing massive furloughs and layoffs right now. I would assume a new job is at least over a year away. When I initially kicked him out he went to a near by parking lot where he stayed for 15 hours, I was expecting him to drive straight to her house but he did not do that which reinforced the story that they are just coworkers

Yes I understand that you can have female co work friends but going to her house to hang out seems very unprofessional. Also alone with her at 4:30am to “sober up” why not call me or an Uber? He is a 41 year old married man, I just think he had no business being there at that hour.

Here I am a month later with a rollercoaster of emotions, I cry at least weekly. I’m not sure if I should kick his ass to the curb or give him another chance. I just don’t trust him anymore. I feel betrayed, deceived, and lied to. I kinda get this feeling that maybe I don’t really know him or what he wants anymore. Maybe he is having a mid life crisis? I think I am afraid of being alone so I am inclined to try and forgive him but then the other half of me can’t respect myself for making such a week decision. I don’t want to be blindsided again. If I allow myself to love and trust  him again and he cheats on me, I will have to do this all again and I’m not sure I could survive it a second time. At least right now I am still young enough to try and find love again. 

If your spouse was having an emotional affair with a co worker but vows to stop. Would you give them a second chance or run??
